reason: The current Security 00/1.1 evidence proves desktop keyboard access to the article-to-watch link and real mobile touch for teaching controls, video start, and reader-next navigation, but it did not prove the article-to-watch link itself or the watch-to-article return path with a real touch gesture. Add a focused actual-built-page mobile round-trip gate for ES/EN under normal/reduced motion: article link visible and viewport-bounded, real tap to the locale-correct watch URL, prominent watch player present, watch source link visible and viewport-bounded, real tap back to the exact article, persistent runtime/resource listeners throughout, and no post-round-trip horizontal overflow. Do not change content/media thresholds. Preserve SOURCE/RENDERED global failures and MEDIA_PASS fail-closed for four silent MP4s plus missing captions/transcripts/curated chapter maps. PIXEL_REVIEW and PEDAGOGY_REVIEW remain manual and must not be inferred from this technical gate.
